title: Hire a San Francisco Photographer for your Bay Area vacation
includes: Access to purchase high-quality prints and albums
Location tips like Baker Beach or Sutro Baths
Wardrobe and posing guidance during the shoot
Slideshow of session highlights set to music
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
You're not just booking a photographer—you're choosing an experience that can become one of the highlights of your San Francisco visit. 

As a long-time Bay Area photographer, I know how to match the perfect location, lighting, and time of day to your vision, creating photographs that feel natural, authentic, and uniquely San Francisco. 

Before your session, I'll personally help you plan the details, from selecting the ideal location to offering wardrobe recommendations, so you can simply relax and enjoy the experience. 

Every session is thoughtfully tailored to your personality and style, allowing genuine moments to unfold naturally. Clients often tell me they arrived feeling nervous but left saying, "That was fun." That's exactly what I hope you'll say too. 

My goal isn't just to deliver beautiful photographs—it's to create an experience and memories you'll treasure long after your visit.
